# Archivist Grim

### Lore
Arcana/Religion (Common): There exists a holy  
ritual, practiced quietly in many sects, by which a  
living creature may be interred in the  
foundation of a building, after which its  
spirit is bound to keep eternal vigil against  
the intrusion of malevolent forces. 

Dark though this practice may be, it remains somewhat common because there is perhaps no  
surer or more lasting way to preserve hallowed  
ground against spiritual defilement. 

These sacrificial spirit guardians  
are called Grim.  
Arcana/Religion (Uncommon):  
Grim spirits are typically conjured  
forth from creatures that are holy  
or otherwise significant to the site  
they are meant to guard, though  
even creatures of full  
sapience can be made  
grim; people of  
extraordinary  
devotion to their  
cause have even been  
known do so voluntarily, most frequently to  
preserve great collections of knowledge or sealed evils. 

### Tactics
Archivist grims wander the libraries and scriptorums to which they are bound, endlessly cataloging and organizing and tidying their collections; so long as their collection is not disturbed or endangered, they remain indifferent to other creatures, though will present menacingly to creatures that disturb the peace or quiet of their space.

They rarely speak, though may offer silent direction to those respectfully attempting to navigate the site.

In combat, archivist grims prioritize the protection of their collection above all else, using Fictive Twist to prevent destructive spells from harming it (along with protecting any allied  Constructs), and Consign to Myth at each opportunity to seal wielders of such magics away.

They use their Scribe's Mastery primarily targeting enemy spellcasters who may be expected to carry scrolls, and may use Fictive Twist on spells cast in this way as well, either to target a weak saving throw or to protect their collection.

If defeated, they lose the ability to fight but remain present; they often become more talkative or characterful at this point, as the magics binding them to their purpose are temporarily loosened. 

## Archivist Grim cr 10
A stooped, looming shadow glides among the silent stacks; even dust seems frozen in its wake, fearful to draw its ire.

AC         14
HP         153 (34d8)
Speed      Fly 30 ft. (hover)

Initiative +4 (14)
Size       Medium (7 ft. tall) 
Type       Undead (Incorporeal)

MOD SAVE
Str 1 -5 -5
Int 21 +5 +9
Dex 19 +4 +4
Wis 17 +3 +7
Con 10 +0 +0
Cha 17 +3 +7

Resistances  Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing 
Immunities  Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, Turned, Unconscious
Senses      Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 13
Languages   The languages it knew in life, Telepathy 120 ft.
Drives      Catalog Everything, Enforce Quiet, Preserve Collection
XP          5,900 Proficiency Bonus +4

### Traits
Chained Vigil. If the grim is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it becomes Incapacitated but is not destroyed unless its bones are exhumed and reburied.

Stifling Aura. The grim projects magical silence in a 30-foot Emanation. Creatures in the area have Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

### Actions
Multiattack. The grim makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Scribe's Mastery.

Inkwrought Bonds. Ranged Spell Attack: +9, range 30 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) Poison damage and the target is Restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 17). 

Scribe's Mastery. The grim unbinds the magic of a scroll within 60 feet, casting the spell contained within (+9 to hit, Save DC 17). If the scroll is carried by a creature, the grim casts a randomly selected scroll carried by the creature. 

Consign to Myth (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell). One creature the grim touches must make a Charisma  Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target disappears into a book within 15 feet of it (Save Ends at end of turn) and gains the benefit of a Short Rest. 

After three failed saving throws, the creature stops repeating the saving throw. The spell ends if the book is opened or destroyed.

### Reactions
Fictive Twist (Level 2 Spell). Trigger: A creature the grim can see within 60 feet casts a spell.  Response:  The spell's effect becomes an illusion, with the following effects.
  Any damage the spell deals becomes Psychic damage.
  Any saving throw the spell forces a creature to make becomes an Intelligence Saving Throw.
